passages.note: Senate roll call 58 on the motion to concur in SB 1(ss), the chamber's final adoption of the bill text, not a procedural motion; Holdman is in the Yea list.

passages.provision_quote: Abortion shall in all instances be SEA 1(ss) — Concur 13 a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances:
passages.note: Enrolled act text: the amended IC 16-34-2-1 bans abortion except where necessary to prevent a serious health risk or save the woman's life, for a lethal fetal anomaly, or where the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.
Bill details page: single-subject abortion bill, signed by the Governor and enacted as Public Law 179(ss) on 08/05/2022; the page prints a digest, not operative text.

rows.reasoning: Holdman voted Yea on the Senate's concurrence in SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill whose enrolled text makes abortion "a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances:" — a serious health risk to or the life of the pregnant woman, a lethal fetal anomaly, or a pregnancy that "is a result of rape or incest". That is the rung "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life"; the enumerated exceptions exclude "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions", and the absence of any general first-trimester permission excludes "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health".
